mapper.select:
/* MyOrderSQL.selectMyOrderList */ SELECT A.ORD_NO AS "ordNo", DATE_FORMAT(A.ORD_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "ordDt", A.PAY_AMT AS "payAmt", A.RECIVER_NM AS "reciverNm", CASE A.ORD_STAT_CD WHEN '10' THEN '주문확인' WHEN '20' THEN '결제완료' WHEN '30' THEN '배송준비' WHEN '40' THEN '배송중' WHEN '50' THEN '배송완료' WHEN '90' THEN '주문취소' END AS "ordStatNm", A.ORD_STAT_CD AS "ordStatCd", CASE A.PAY_TP_CD WHEN '10' THEN '무통장입금' WHEN '20' THEN '카드결제' END AS "payTpNm", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORD_DTL WHERE ORD_NO = A.ORD_NO) AS "dtlCnt", (SELECT B2.PRD_NM FROM TB_ORD_DTL B1 INNER JOIN TB_PRD_MST B2 ON B1.PRD_CD = B2.PRD_CD WHERE B1.ORD_NO = A.ORD_NO AND B1.ORD_SEQ = 1) AS "firstPrdNm", (SELECT C.IMG_PATH FROM TB_ORD_DTL B1 LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON B1.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE B1.ORD_NO = A.ORD_NO AND B1.ORD_SEQ = 1) AS "imgPath", D.INVOICE_NO AS "invoiceNo", CASE D.DELV_CO_CD WHEN 'CJ' THEN 'CJ대한통운' WHEN 'HANJIN' THEN '한진택배' WHEN 'LOTTE' THEN '롯데택배' WHEN 'POST' THEN '우체국택배' WHEN 'LOGEN' THEN '로젠택배' END AS "delvCoNm" FROM TB_ORD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_ORD_DELV_INFO D ON A.ORD_NO = D.ORD_NO
ORDER BY A.ORD_DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{limitStart}

/* MyOrderSQL.selectMyOrderDtl */ SELECT A.ORD_NO AS "ordNo", DATE_FORMAT(A.ORD_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "ordDt", A.ORD_STAT_CD AS "ordStatCd", CASE A.ORD_STAT_CD WHEN '10' THEN '주문확인' WHEN '20' THEN '결제완료' WHEN '30' THEN '배송준비' WHEN '40' THEN '배송중' WHEN '50' THEN '배송완료' WHEN '90' THEN '주문취소' END AS "ordStatNm", A.PAY_TP_CD AS "payTpCd", CASE A.PAY_TP_CD WHEN '10' THEN '무통장입금' WHEN '20' THEN '카드결제' END AS "payTpNm", A.PAY_AMT AS "payAmt", A.DELV_AMT AS "delvAmt", A.DEPOSITOR_NM AS "depositorNm", A.PG_APRV_NO AS "pgAprvNo", DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(A.ORD_DT, INTERVAL 3 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS "payLimitDt", A.RECIVER_NM AS "reciverNm", A.DELV_HP_NO AS "delvHpNo", A.DELV_ZIPCODE AS "delvZipcode", A.DELV_BASE_ADDR AS "delvBaseAddr", A.DELV_DTL_ADDR AS "delvDtlAddr", A.DELV_MSG AS "delvMsg", D.INVOICE_NO AS "invoiceNo", CASE D.DELV_CO_CD WHEN 'CJ' THEN 'CJ대한통운' WHEN 'HANJIN' THEN '한진택배' WHEN 'LOTTE' THEN '롯데택배' WHEN 'POST' THEN '우체국택배' WHEN 'LOGEN' THEN '로젠택배' END AS "delvCoNm" FROM TB_ORD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_ORD_DELV_INFO D ON A.ORD_NO = D.ORD_NO WHERE A.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND A.MBR_NO = #{mbrNo}

/* MyOrderSQL.selectMyOrderPrdList */ SELECT A.ORD_SEQ AS "ordSeq", A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", B.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", B.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", A.ORD_QTY AS "ordQty", A.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", A.DISC_AMT AS "discAmt", A.ORD_AMT AS "ordAmt", C.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath" FROM TB_ORD_DTL A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_MST B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 WHERE A.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY A.ORD_SEQ
/* MyOrderSQL.selectOrderPrdQtyList */ SELECT PRD_CD AS "prdCd", ORD_QTY AS "ordQty" FROM TB_ORD_DTL WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY ORD_SEQ
mapper.update: /* MyOrderSQL.updatePrdStockRestore */ UPDATE TB_PRD_MST SET STOCK_QTY = STOCK_QTY + #{ordQty}, PRD_STAT_CD = CASE WHEN PRD_STAT_CD = '40' THEN '30' ELSE PRD_STAT_CD END, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRD_CD = #{prdCd} AND (STOCK_QTY > 0 OR PRD_STAT_CD = '40')
